reviewer: Codex with one fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer

claims.summary: For every fixed-degree ternary one-hot Tseitin graph with nonzero total charge, s=n+m+1, there exists a binary original-input noncommutative IPS certificate C of degree O_Delta(s) such that every degree-r word tensor flattened across any subset of positions has F2 matrix rank O_Delta(s^2), also after positionwise F2-linear tensor maps. C has a constant-depth F4 sum-of-products-of-homogeneous-linear-forms formula of size O_Delta(s^3). Use C=omega^2 D+omega sigma(D) for the earlier F4 certificate, with coefficientwise Frobenius fixing letters. No constant-depth F2 formula or membership in the matched shallow simulation image is claimed.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter rank witness, passed by the sole fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer. Refutes the large-rank premise for all certificates, not a premise restricted to already-small binary certificates or the matched image.
claims.rationale: Tests the proposed universal word-matrix-rank premise on the actual family, including all commutator and Boolean placeholders, and identifies the role of coefficient field.
claims.next_action: Retain field-sensitive or proof-image-sensitive alternatives; do not infer a binary shallow upper bound from an F4 formula.

claims.summary: For fixed maximum degree Delta, canonical positive integer-flow CNFs on a nonempty finite simple graph with n vertices and m edges have original-input noncommutative IPS formulas of size O_Delta((n+m+1)^4) and constant ordered unbounded-fan-in depth over K=F_(2^a) of size O(m+1), retaining Boolean and commutator generators. A binary-coefficient certificate has a constant-depth K formula with an extra O(log(m+2)) size factor, by coefficientwise trace. Local Laurent characters cancel globally while positivity removes the constant coefficient; interpolate exponents [-2m,2m] at 4m+1 nonzero points. Isolated vertices have a unit input. No binary constant-depth formula or simultaneous small word-rank claim for flow is made.
claims.assessment: Working complete Laurent-parameter and field-trace construction, passed by the sole fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer with exact local GAP controls. Shallow extension formulas need not have small word flattenings; binary constant-depth complexity remains open.
claims.rationale: Shows that removing fixed vertex character values does not by itself remove extension-field shallow certificates; the original binary goal remains open.
claims.next_action: Check the row/column counting construction on unary PHP with a full original-clause and Laurent-range ledger, rather than assume counting intuition supplies it.

relationships: Uses the full pre-descent F4 certificate and its O(s^2) products of homogeneous linear factors, including all original placeholders.
The rank tensor is defined algebraically; extracting homogeneous components is not claimed to preserve binary formula depth.
The witness refutes an all-certificate rank premise but is not proved to lie in this binary fixed-depth simulation image.
Reuses paid global edge sorting and local inverse factors, replacing fixed vertex characters with Laurent coefficient extraction.
The earlier PC degree upper bound is a different resource; the new result concerns constant-depth extension-field formula certificates for the same canonical local predicates.
Interpolation is explicitly over a growing extension; no same-depth return to binary constants is inferred.
